note: Major injuries the progression model can't see (Achilles, ACL, ...). rate_mult multiplies his FP/G path from year 2 on; year 1 stays the projection, so a lost season goes in that season's overrides file as gp. Read by sim.py progression. Example row: "Name": {"rate_mult": 0.9, "reason": "torn Achilles 2026-05"}
